title: Results can go straight into a calculation
why: A plain conversion loses or misreads every "below a limit" result, and that inflates averages. This is a normal way to report results. It needs a stated method, not a correction.
action: Publish the method for below-limit results, and use it everywhere.
Rule Threshold Text: Never fails outright. Needs review above 10%. Illustrative.
Rule Effect Text: Average river ammonia with below-limit results dropped, against counted at half the limit: 1.08 worked out carefully, 1.75 carelessly (mg/l). That moves it by +61.9%.
Rule Test Text: Caught at the last check: its count rose from 214,679 to 214,682 when its own defect was planted in a private copy.
